shape: variant of menu-choices-worded-differently-1: the menu filters its choices by whatever is typed, so typing the answer ("Yes") empties it ("No options") while the choices as it opened can still be asked about
why: Ocado Technology (found 2026-10-10), 11 Oct 2026 (0.9.209): the required right-to-work menu opened on the click and showed "No options": the answer "Yes" matched none of its sentence choices, so the text typed to filter it emptied the list and the row was left. The app now picks the choice that means the same from the menu's own choices (extension/combo-click.js choose, /extension/pick-choice).

control.guard: follow-up case to the fix 9562e0d (Fix-commit): fails on the build before it (the answer is typed at first; the list empties and no pick is asked); passes since

sample: hand-cut page (a click-only select whose choices are sentences, 12 Oct 2026; no real site text)

/extension/pick-choice.choice: I have the Right to Work in the location where the position is based

asked: Do you have the right to work in the location where the position is based or do you require a Visa?
